## Change and reason

Identify the chapter, claim, source record, or reader problem.

## Evidence inspected

Give editions, locators, lawful links, and the actual inspection scope.

## Verification and limitations

Record reproduction steps, review performed, alternatives, and what remains unverified. Do not equate a stylistic measurement with a theological conclusion.

## Permissions

Confirm you may submit the material under the applicable project license. Identify third-party material and its terms. Do not include personal data or unauthorized copies.
